snippet.title: Werewolf: The Apocalypse - Rageborn | Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Werewolf: The Apocalypse - Rageborn on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3746290/Werewolf_The_Apocalypse__Rageborn/

Embrace the fury. Become the weapon. Step into the role of a Garou and unleash your rage! 

Werewolf: The Apocalypse - Rageborn is a mature action Metroidvania set in the World of Darkness universe, blending visceral combat, exploration, and deep RPG progression.

Shift between forms, tear through your enemies, and harness the raw power of the beast within. Every battle is a dance between control and chaos, and giving in might be your only way to survive.
